name: Kestrel Mobile

ring.prompt: You've reached Kestrel Mobile. Calls are recorded for training. Hold the line, please, while we take you through the options.

menu.prompt: For upgrades, press one. For billing, press two. To close or transfer an account after a bereavement, press three. For technical support, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: Hmm, that didn't work. Give it another go from the menu.

holdAnnouncement: Did you know you can manage most things in the Kestrel app? An adviser will be with you soon.

clerk.greeting: Hiya, you're through to Dara at Kestrel. I can see you've come through the bereavement line — I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you give me the account holder's full name, and the date they passed away?

turns.reprompt: No rush at all — just the full name on the account and the date they passed, when you're ready.

turns.say: Thanks for that. And can I take your own name and your relationship to them?
turns.reprompt: Just your name and how you're related, and we're nearly done.

documents: a copy of the death certificate — a photo uploaded in the app is fine
outcome.closing: I've closed the account from today and cleared the final bill, so there's nothing to pay. Your reference is {REF}. Mind yourself now.

quirk: Waives the final bill on the call — the friendliest script of the twelve.
